s0.ru: Субфакториал: !(0) = 1, !(1) = 0, дальше !(n) = (n-1)*(!(n-1)+!(n-2)). Число перестановок n элементов с k неподвижными точками равно C(n, k)*!(n-k). Коэффициент C(a, b) — произведение (a-b+i)/i по i от 1 до b. Сколько перестановок {n} элементов имеют ровно {k} неподвижных точек?
s0.en: The subfactorial is !(0) = 1, !(1) = 0, then !(n) = (n-1)*(!(n-1)+!(n-2)). The number of permutations of n elements with k fixed points is C(n, k)*!(n-k). The coefficient C(a, b) is the product (a-b+i)/i for i from 1 to b. How many permutations of {n} elements have exactly {k} fixed points?

s1.en: The subfactorial is !(0) = 1, !(1) = 0, then !(n) = (n-1)*(!(n-1)+!(n-2)). The number of permutations of n elements with k fixed points is C(n, k)*!(n-k). The coefficient C(a, b) is the product (a-b+i)/i for i from 1 to b. What is the sum of these numbers for k from 0 to {n}?
